dct_title_s: South America, plans on the coast of Venezuela, Puerto Chichiriviche (Raster Image)
dct_description_sm: This layer is a georeferenced raster image of a map panel showing Puerto Chichiriviche. This panel is part of a nautical chart titled "South America, plans on the coast of Venezuela" originally published by the United States Defense Mapping Agency in 1996. This layer is 1 of 2 panel maps representing the original source sheet map. Map no. 24455.

Historic paper maps can provide an excellent view of the changes that have occurred in the cultural and physical landscape. The wide range of information provided on these maps make them useful in the study of historic geography, and urban and rural land use change. As this map has been georeferenced, it can be used in a GIS as a source or background layer in conjunction with other GIS data.
